integrity: A reproducible exact finite chamber enumeration and proof are supplied in RESULT.md and verify.py. The source method is credited; no external mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only generic central sections of the regular truncated icosahedron; chamber multiplicities are not Haar probabilities, and individual probability masses, section areas and off-center sections are not determined. Historical priority is provisional.
title: All generic central-section side counts of the regular truncated icosahedron
